scope: Explicit native text file-tool Profile fragment only, Windows x64 local NTFS, pinned official published host components. Not a complete user Profile or full SEP activation.

config.files: Same explicit registered project/cwd and bounded recovery settings as file-protection.
config.tools: Official tool-fs Config; native defaults retained.

notVerified: controlled replacement of existing full user Profile
onObservationPolicyUnload: undefined intent refused as FS_NOT_OBSERVED; no unconditional fallback
scopeRestriction: Sandbox session mode and native denial markers retained; even danger-full-access is confined to the one registered protected root. Approval is owned by the native host. Ordinary Shell is unchanged.
rollback: Failed child activation disposes only this component children in reverse order; native sandbox and user services retained.
postCommitCapacity: Successful durable mutation remains success; receipt may be omitted at capacity, and later guarded modification is refused.
